prompt: Composition: Narrow index beside an unframed detail pane; index becomes a menu on mobile. Build for this brief: A software product; users scan records and complete repeated tasks. Set headings in Junicode and reading text in Aileron; humanist reading serif with economical sans text. Use Spectrum 1-6: page #FAF9FB, text #2D1F27, accent #86241D, secondary surface #EAEFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 18px, heading 28px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
